item.title: Environment and climate
item.description: Words for talking about climate change, pollution and protecting nature.

children.definition: gases that are sent into the air, for example from cars and factories
children.example: Electric buses can help cut emissions in the city centre.

children.definition: a situation where there is not enough clean water for people's needs
children.example: Water scarcity is a serious concern for farmers in dry regions.

children.definition: (of energy) coming from sources that do not run out, like the sun or wind
children.example: The country plans to produce more renewable energy from solar farms.

children.definition: coal, oil and gas, which were formed in the ground over millions of years
children.example: Burning fossil fuels is the main cause of rising carbon dioxide levels.

children.definition: the amount of harmful gas your activities produce
children.example: Taking the train instead of flying reduces your carbon footprint.

children.definition: (of an animal or plant) at risk of disappearing completely
children.example: Some endangered animals now live only in a few protected areas.

children.definition: the protection of nature, animals and natural resources
children.example: She works for a water conservation project in Karakalpakstan.

children.definition: the variety of plants and animals living in a particular area
children.example: Wetlands support a rich biodiversity of birds and fish.

children.definition: the cutting down of trees over a large area
children.example: Deforestation makes floods and landslides more likely.

children.definition: able to continue for a long time without damaging the environment
children.example: Drip irrigation is a more sustainable way to water cotton fields.

children.definition: a period of unusually hot weather
children.example: During the heatwave, it was over 40 degrees for a whole week.

children.definition: a large area where rubbish is buried under the ground
children.example: Most of the city's rubbish still ends up in landfill.
